newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - UBS cuts Ultramar.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - UBS cuts Ultramar.

text.p: UBS Securities said it downgraded Ultramar Diamond Shamrock Corp to hold from buy.
-- said reached six-month price target of $34.
-- cut 1997 earnings per share estimate to $2.20 from $2.50 and 1998 view to $3.20 from $3.55.

-- cited recent issuance of trust originated preferred shares, slight reduction in UBS's 1997 West Coast and eastern Canadian refining margin assumptions, and a "modest" cut in UBS's assumptions for the company's retail fuel volumes and merchandise sales assumptions for 1997 and 1998.
